title: GroundTruthSampleSchema
description: Standard machine-readable schema for individual physical ground truth annotation trials in Swim Analyzer AI

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for this ground truth sample (e.g. GT-FREE-001)

participant_id.description: Pseudonymized participant identifier. Direct PII is strictly forbidden.

session_id.description: Identifier for the recording session or capture protocol

stroke_type.description: Target swimming style for this trial

video_id.description: Identifier linking to the raw or preprocessed video asset

video_sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of the raw video asset

source_type.description: Origin apparatus for the ground truth measurement

annotation_version.description: Schema and protocol version used for annotation

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the primary certified annotator or consensus panel

secondary_annotator_id.description: Identifier of the independent second rater if dual-annotated

annotation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when annotation was completed

video_fps.description: True constant frame rate of the video recording

video_duration.description: Total duration of video trial in seconds

frame_count.description: Total number of frames in the video

metric_annotations.description: Standardized ground truth metric values. Explicitly distinguishes physical quantities from proxy measures.

stroke_rate_spm.description: Measured physical cycle rate in strokes per minute

cycle_duration_ms.description: Measured physical mean cycle duration in milliseconds

true_dps_meters.description: MEASURED PHYSICAL QUANTITY: True center-of-mass translation per cycle in meters. Null if uncalibrated.

hand_excursion_proxy_bl.description: PROXY / ESTIMATE: Normalized wrist travel distance relative to torso body length. NOT literal center-of-mass translation.

mean_elbow_angle_deg.description: MEASURED PHYSICAL QUANTITY: Mean elbow angle during pull phase in degrees.

mean_knee_angle_deg.description: MEASURED PHYSICAL QUANTITY: Mean knee flexion angle in degrees.

body_roll_amplitude_deg.description: Peak-to-peak or peak shoulder/hip roll angle in degrees.

stroke_symmetry_percent.description: Symmetry percentage between left and right limb kinematics (0 - 100).

annotation_notes.description: Qualitative notes recorded by the human annotator regarding visual conditions or edge cases.

exclusion_status.description: Quality gating status. Only 'INCLUDED' samples may enter official validation cohorts.

exclusion_reason.description: Detailed explanation if exclusion_status is EXCLUDED or AMBIGUOUS

is_synthetic_fixture.description: CRITICAL: True ONLY if this sample is a software test mock. Synthetic fixtures must NEVER enter official validation cohorts.
